citations.quote: be forced to liquidate positions in financial assets to deal with an unexpected funding need

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Funding-constrained intermediaries forced to liquidate (fire sales) push prices below fundamentals; because arbitrageurs share those constraints, mispricing can persist and amplify through a funding/market-liquidity feedback.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Funding Liquidity, Fire Sales, and Limits to Arbitrage
